# Beseam

> Beseam makes AI a revenue channel for webshops. It is the easiest way to get your products recommended by AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Mode, Perplexity and Copilot to millions of shoppers.

Beseam connects to a Shopify webshop in one click, tracks where the store's products appear in AI answers, and optimises product descriptions, content and technical performance so assistants recommend them. Improvements are ranked by expected revenue impact; the merchant approves them or lets Beseam apply trusted types of change automatically, and every change stays reversible.

## Product

- https://beseam.com/product/ai-visibility-tracking — track when AI assistants recommend your products, who appears instead, and what it earns you
- https://beseam.com/product/product-descriptions — product descriptions and product data that AI understands and recommends
- https://beseam.com/product/content-creation — collection pages, comparisons, blogs and guides that put a webshop in AI answers
- https://beseam.com/product/technical-performance — structured data, crawler access and page speed, so AI can read every page

## Crawling and data

- https://beseam.com/bot — BeseamBot crawler information
- https://beseam.com/robots.txt — crawler policy
- https://beseam.com/sitemap.xml — public site map
- Published AI shopping data contains observations of public brands only; no private customer or merchant data is included.
- AI answers are point-in-time observations and can change. A brand appearance is not a ranking, endorsement, or guarantee.
- Beseam does not claim to know an assistant's hidden ranking logic.
